document.about: The Journal of Headache and Pain (2016) article, PMC4791410, set in two columns. On p3 its Table 1 runs down the left column and Table 2 sits at the foot of the right one, the two tables' last rows side by side, under the right column's prose. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#358): a reading of the figures across both columns (Table 1's last rows with Table 2's) beat Table 2's own reading, and the right column's prose was read as a column of Table 1. A reading across the page's gutter, between two columns of text, is now read again in each column.

checks.issue: #358: Table 2's figures were read in a table with Table 1's last rows, its `Female` and `p` heads loose text.
#358: the right column's paragraph was cut into the rows of Table 1, a line to a row.
checks.text: we found that osmophobia was associated with more frequent incidences of nausea
